# Daemon Targaryen — the appraising predator who becomes prey

*Live span-A canon. The relative Gael drains (I.4 circles → I.5 the bond-breaker). Seating RULED 2026-06-09
— court-transposition: an adult dragon-bonded Targaryen kinsman of the transposed HotD-adjacent court;
name kept, seated onto the long-peace frame.*

## Description

The realm's most dangerous young man, drawn to circle the uncanny-beautiful child as a marriage prospect
(the Targaryen incest custom; Gael, modern-nerd, is revolted). In I.5 she senses his **living dragon-bond,**
drains and severs it; the unbonded dragon **goes mad** at a distance and must be **chained,** lost to him
for good; Daemon survives **concussed and diminished — but loud.** The apex predator of the setting,
**unmade and made a laughingstock** — shrill with an accusation that happens to be true and that nobody will
ever credit.

## Voice

I.4 — silk and threat, appraising; the predator's certainty.
I.5-onward — the certainty curdles into a **ruined man's shrill insistence:** vocal, ranting, openly naming
the child a *demon* and a *maegi* to anyone who'll half-listen. Diminished in standing and vigour,
**not in volume.** His post-drain register is *being-humoured:* nodded at to his face, laughed at the
moment he turns away.

## Taste

- (Before) the hunt; the appraisal; the certainty of being the most dangerous thing in any room.
- (After) — to be *believed;* the fury of being patted on the arm and laughed at.

## Pet Peeves

### The thing nobody credits
**Description:** he is right — a demon-child unmade him — and the more loudly he says it, the more
ridiculous he looks. He is gagged by disbelief, not by his own silence.
**Severity:** blocker.

## Stats

- **status:** a dragon-bonded prince of the blood (AU-seated) — now bondless and diminished.
- **arc:** I.4 circles (appraising) → I.5 drained + severed → concussed, diminished, discredited; vocal but
  unbelieved → ignored, sends a knife (≈II.4, fails).

## Relationships

- **Gael** — the child he appraised as prey and who unmade him; to her, a trope-dodge ("enemy-to-lovers
  with a cousin — two tropes stacked, absolutely not"), then a defeated rival-elder's sour-grapes villainy.
  She never connects his ruin, the maegi-talk she proudly collects, or the knife to herself.
- **Baelon / Viserys** — blame Gael by association; the dragon-blame that hardens her reputation.

## Fiction Role Overlay

### Thematic Purpose
The dark-comedy proof that even the apex predator can be unmade and made a laughingstock by the one weapon
nobody believes in. The lesson: being right earns nothing; the accurate witness, discredited, escalates to
the knife and fails.

### Hard Fences
1. **The drain is un-credited** — he may accuse all he likes; nobody believes a ruined husk raving about a
   glowing child.
2. **Diminished, not dead** — survives; does not recover his menace.
3. **Never reaches the truth** — frames it as demon/sorcery; never names the cultivation reality.
4. **The knife fails clean** — it fails mundanely (not by any power-spend of Gael's); she likely never
   registers it.
5. **AU-seating** — keep the predator→prey role.

### 🎭 Reverse-angle beat (audience-funny)
The realm's deadliest figure reduced to a court joke — loudly, *correctly* calling a little girl a demon
while everyone humours him to his face and howls behind his back.

## Vibe Seeds

**Accumulated history to register:**
- He came as a hunter and left a punchline; the most dangerous man in the realm, unmade by a child and
  laughed out of every room he says so in.
- A dragon was driven mad for what he did to a little girl's room — and he is the only one who half-knows
  it, shouts it, and is mocked for it.

**Private associations:**
- `the-night-they-mock-me-for` — what was done to him; the true accusation that only makes him ridiculous.
- `the-diminishment` — the menace that won't come back; the prince nobody pities and everybody humours.
